name: MT Newswires
description: MT Newswires' MCP server delivers real-time, low-latency financial news across equities, fixed income, commodities, FX, and macroeconomics. Structured and machine-readable, it integrates seamlessly into AI, trading, and analytics systems, providing scalable, reliable, event-driven intelligence from MT Newswires' global newsroom trusted by leading banks, brokerages, and data providers.

_published_faq.name: How do I add MT Newswires to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add MT Newswires to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mtnewswires.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the MT Newswires MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: MT Newswires provides these MCP tools: fetch_news_by_security, fetch_news_batch, search_news, search_news_by_metacode, list_metacodes, format_news, and onboarding.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to MT Newswires?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to MT Newswires in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does MT Newswires MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: MT Newswires requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
MT Newswires is developed by MT Newswires. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
